subject: PO reservation & line-item normalization for CloudForge onboarding
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@cloudforge.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: accounts-payable@cloudforge.com
Date: 2026-04-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial PO placeholder for Redwood onboarding

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the call this morning. Per our procurement team, we've provisionally reserved PO placeholder 8472 so we can start onboarding and provisioning. Attached is a one-page PO placeholder (CF_PO_PLACEHOLDER_8472.pdf).

A few notes/questions from our side: 
- The invoice will initially include three SKUs but CloudForge needs those split across two cost centers (ENG-Platform and ENG-Product) - can Redwood accept split-line invoices?
- We have a $120k annual spend cap requested for the initial quarter while we validate usage. Can PO 8472 be set with a provisional spend cap and then updated after the first billing run?

If you need a contact in AP for the invoice flow, loop in accounts-payable@cloudforge.com.

Best,
Liam
Director, Vendor Ops
CloudForge
From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@cloudforge.com>, accounts-payable@cloudforge.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-04-28T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial PO placeholder for Redwood onboarding

Hi Liam —

Thanks, received the placeholder and the attached matrix (I reviewed it). Short answers up front: yes, we can accept split-line invoices; and we can create a provisional spend cap on the PO while we complete account provisioning.

Next steps from Redwood: 
- I'll create a formal PO number tied to the placeholder (we'll issue PO RWD-2026-8472) by EOD today.
- Marissa will confirm the cost-center mapping and send a line-item matrix back to you for validation.
- Aditya will scope the billing tolerances and set a provisional $120,000 spend cap as requested; we will mark the cap as provisional with a 30-day review.

Questions for CloudForge: 
1) Please confirm the exact line descriptions and unit counts you expect on month 1 so we can pre-seed the invoice parser. The current attachment has generic SKUs.
2) Who will sign the final PO? If you prefer DocuSign, share the email address for signature routing.

I'll follow up with the official PO number and a signed PDF.

Thanks,
Irene
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@cloudforge.com>, irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-04-28T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial PO placeholder for Redwood onboarding

On Tue, Apr 28, 2026 at 10:05 AM Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Liam —
>
> Thanks, received the placeholder and the attached matrix (I reviewed it). Short answers up front: yes, we can accept split-line invoices; and we can create a provisional spend cap on the PO while we complete account provisioning.
>
> Next steps from Redwood: 
> - I'll create a formal PO number tied to the placeholder (we'll issue PO RWD-2026-8472) by EOD today.
>
Thanks all — adding the cost-center allocation here. Liam, I made a version of the line-item matrix with the suggested cost-center and quantity splits (attached: lineitem_matrix_v2.xlsx). Please review rows 3 and 4 in particular — CloudForge previously listed them as a bundled SKU, but we need them separated onto two invoice lines to match our internal chargeback rules.

Marissa Cole
Finance Ops Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@cloudforge.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: accounts-payable@cloudforge.com
Date: 2026-04-28T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial PO placeholder for Redwood onboarding

Thanks Marissa — got the matrix.

Quick replies: 
- We can split SKU CF-CORE-1 into two invoice lines (CF-CORE-1A and CF-CORE-1B) and map them to ENG-Platform and ENG-Product as you requested.
- Signature: I'll be the signer, and DocuSign is fine. Please route the envelope to liam.oneill@cloudforge.com.
- Provisional spend cap of $120,000 sounds reasonable. We would like a note in the PO referencing a 30-day review so our procurement can autosync.

I'll ask AP to prepare an initial invoice that references the placeholder and note the split lines; they will send it to accounts-payable@redwood.com.

—Liam
From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: accounts-payable@cloudforge.com, liam.oneill@cloudforge.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: 2026-04-29T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: PO issued: RWD-2026-8472 and provisional spend cap details

Hello —

This note confirms we've issued PO RWD-2026-8472 for CloudForge and attached the signed PDF to the procurement record (DocuSign envelope: DocuSign: 0a1b2c3d-CloudForge-PO). The PO includes the following provisions: 
- Provisional spend cap: $120,000 annualized for the first 30 days, flagged for review at the next billing cycle.
- Required invoice format: separate lines for CF-CORE-1A (ENG-Platform) and CF-CORE-1B (ENG-Product). Please ensure those exact line IDs appear on the invoice.

AP team — when you send the first invoice, add the placeholder reference (CF-PL-8472) in the invoice notes and include the finalized split lines. If you cannot split, please notify me before sending so we can coordinate a manual allocation.

Attachments: RWD-2026-8472-signed.pdf (linked in procurement portal), lineitem_matrix_v2.xlsx

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
